source.name: Football Shirt Culture: Senegal 2026 Puma Home Kit
source.note: Kit maker. Named-press kit write-up: the shirt carries the Puma logo on the right chest and the Senegal federation crest on the left chest beneath a gold star, with national-identity detailing on the upper back and an authenticity badge near the hem, completed by white shorts and white socks; no commercial sponsor on any placement.
source.quote: The Puma logo is positioned on the right chest in green, with the Senegal federation crest placed on the left chest beneath a single gold star.

summary: Puma home kit for the 2026 World Cup cycle. No commercial shirt sponsors: Football Shirt Culture's launch write-up describes only the Puma logo and the Senegal federation crest on the chest, with national-identity detailing on the upper back and sponsor-free white shorts and socks.
